data.description: The Menotherian's subtle aroma causes creatures in her vicinity to become placid and react favorably towards her. Any creature that fails a DC %1 Fortitude save improves its atitude towards her one step closer to friendly. Creatures with the scent ability take a -4 penalty on this save. Creatures in the aura must save each minute. This is a mind-affecting poison effect.
data.name: Alluring Scent
